Get Data from Prometheus — get_data
code: get_data(   start_time = format(Sys.time() - 60 * 60 * 24 * 7, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),   end_time = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),   urlq = prometheus_url[1] )

title: Get Data from Prometheus — get_data
text: start_time start time format: "2025-01-31T11:48:08Z" end_time end time format: "2025-02-07T11:48:33Z" urlq Prometheus url

text: prometheus_url prometheus url timezone timezone prometheus exports data
